name: one-arm-bottoms-up-kettlebell-bench-press
instructions:
1. Begin in a seated, upright position with the kettlebell handle in one hand and the bottom of the bell in the other.
2. Lay back and position the bottom of the kettlebell towards the ceiling.
3. Press the kettlebell to full extension by contracting the tricep and pec.
4. Lower back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
